description: This Java class, DisbursementData, models immutable disbursement information related to loans in a financial application. It includes details such as disbursement dates, amounts, charges, and methods for comparison and date range checks.

classes.name: DisbursementData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing disbursement details including dates, amounts, and charge information.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Creates a DisbursementData instance from given actual disbursement date, link account ID, row index, locale, and date format.

methods.name: disbursementDate
methods.description: Determines the effective disbursement date, prioritizing actual disbursement date if available.

methods.name: isDisbursed
methods.description: Checks if the loan disbursement has occurred based on the presence of an actual disbursement date.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this disbursement data object with another based on expected disbursement dates.

methods.name: isDueForDisbursement
methods.description: Determines if a disbursement is due within a date range based on the loan schedule type.

methods.name: occursOnDayFromAndUpToAndIncluding
methods.description: Checks if a target date occurs within a date range (exclusive start, inclusive end).

methods.name: occursOnDayFromAndIncludingAndUpTo
methods.description: Checks if a target date occurs within a date range (inclusive start, exclusive end).

methods.name: getWaivedChargeAmount
methods.description: Returns the waived charge amount or zero if null.
